Subject: Renewal onboarding refresh + seat uplift request

Hi Lauren,

Hope you're well — we're coming up on our annual renewal and want to coordinate a short onboarding refresh and a seat/commit uplift. We're planning to increase committed capacity by ~35% starting July 1 and need to make sure procurement has everything to process a PO.

Can you confirm:
- The procurement portal flow (any new steps since last year)
- Whether a SOW addendum is needed for the seat increase and an estimated turnaround time
- Any evidence bundles we should include for our procurement team (SOC2 link, attestation, IP address ranges)

I'm attaching a quick internal checklist so you can see our procurement team's expectations. Ideally we'd lock the SOW/PO path this week so our finance team can issue a PO by 6/18.

Attachments: edgemark_onboarding_quicklist.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Thanks — can we do a 30-min sync tomorrow morning if that works?

— Liam

Edgemark Systems

Subject: Re: Renewal onboarding refresh + seat uplift request

Hi Liam — thanks for the clear checklist, that helps. Quick plan below so procurement can move forward without delays:

1) Procurement portal: no major changes since last year. We'll create a "Renewal + Seat Uplift" workflow that pre-populates the SOW addendum fields. I can kick that off from our side once you confirm the billing address and PO recipient.

2) SOW addendum: we have a short addendum for capacity/term updates. I'm attaching SOW_addendum_RDW-4572_v2.pdf with the uptick and a small net-30 invoice term (if that's OK). If procurement needs net-45 we can discuss but that will go to finance.

3) Evidence bundle: SOC2 link (https://redwood.example/soc2-report), attestation + IP ranges will be included in the portal package. No new security questionnaires anticipated.

Next steps I need from you:
- Confirm billing address and full legal entity name to appear on the PO
- Confirm whether finance needs invoices sent to a separate address (AP email)
- Approve the attached SOW addendum or mark edits; legal review typically takes 48–72 hours for small changes

I'll schedule a 30-min sync for 6/15 9:30am PT — let me know if that works or propose an alternate.

Attachments: SOW_addendum_RDW-4572_v2.pdf (PDF)

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Account Executive, Renewals
Redwood Inference
